# RankLLMs Engine
> High-performance free API and benchmark intelligence engine for 900+ Large Language Models and Foundation AI Models.
> Product: https://rankllms.com · Maintainer: https://codaipro.com

## Core API Endpoints
- Main Leaderboard: https://api.rankllms.com/api/v1/leaderboard
- Query & Filter Models: https://api.rankllms.com/api/v1/models
- Top 200 Model Cards: https://api.rankllms.com/api/v1/models/cards
- Model Comparison: https://api.rankllms.com/api/v1/compare?model_a={slug}&model_b={slug}
- Weekly Top 10: https://api.rankllms.com/api/v1/top-10
- Provider Catalog: https://api.rankllms.com/api/v1/providers
- System Health: https://api.rankllms.com/api/v1/health

- Swagger UI: https://api.rankllms.com/api/v1/docs
- OpenAPI JSON Spec: https://api.rankllms.com/api/v1/openapi.json
